name: multica-bridge
description: Bridge between LunarWing and a Multica/Lunartica task management server. Enables LunarWing to act as a Multica daemon runtime — register, claim tasks, report progress, and post comments.

tools.name: multica
tools.description: Interact with a Multica/Lunartica server. Use action parameter to select operation. Actions: register (register as runtime), heartbeat (keep alive), claim_task (claim next pending task), start_task (mark task started), complete_task (mark task done), fail_task (mark task failed), report_progress (report step progress), list_issues (list workspace issues), get_issue (get issue details), update_issue (update issue fields), post_comment (comment on issue), recover_orphans (recover crashed tasks), report_messages (report agent messages).

action.description: Operation to perform: register, heartbeat, claim_task, start_task, complete_task, fail_task, report_progress, list_issues, get_issue, update_issue, post_comment, recover_orphans, report_messages

task_id.description: Task UUID (required for start_task, complete_task, fail_task, report_progress, report_messages)

issue_id.description: Issue ID — UUID or identifier like MUL-123 (required for get_issue, update_issue, post_comment)

output.description: Completion output text (for complete_task) or progress summary (for report_progress)

pr_url.description: Pull request URL to attach on completion (for complete_task)

status.description: Issue status to set (for update_issue) or filter (for list_issues)

assignee_id.description: Agent UUID to filter by (for list_issues)

auth.instructions: Create a Personal Access Token in your Multica/Lunartica instance: Settings → Tokens → Create Token. Copy the token starting with 'mul_'.
